output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-5b3f3008c357] is just a metric name. But it sits in the list under the section intro [ev-1f419676f177], which spells out the change. In 3.0.0, Loki metrics that started with `cortex_` are renamed to start with `loki_`, so this metric becomes `loki_query_frontend_connected_schedulers`. Only setups where `metrics_namespace` stays at its default `loki` are affected; setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. Anything that queries the old `cortex_` name will no longer find it. One caveat: [ev-1f419676f177] also says `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release, and it is a little inconsistent about the default, but the 3.0.0 rename and the way to opt out are stated directly.
